reviews.comment: grade is based solely on 3 exams. kolaris a super cool dude w/ great stories and general passion for the material. he bumps people up pretty generously and his class content is pretty simple. study the powerpoints and you'll be fine.

Kolari's easily been the best professor I've had in any Mays class. Never met another professor so passionate about his career and the material he teaches. Tests are cake if you go to class and take half decent notes. There's a final paper at the end that can be annoying but he doesn't grade it strictly at all. Take him for 381 for sure

Prof. Kolari really cares about his students and wants them to succeed. His course isn't terribly hard, but it will challenge you a little and there is a big paper at the end. Great Prof would definitely take again.

A professor with an extensive knowledge within finance and capital markets that resembles a Milton Friedman of our time. Experience working for the Federal Reserve and academia at home and abroad. Extremely passionate about students learning, less focused on grades. Will probably win a Nobel Price for his ZCAPM theory which he just published. MUST
